---
format:
  typst: default
---

```{=typst}
#let navy = rgb("#1E2B55")
#let charcoal = rgb("#20262D")
#let slate = rgb("#596673")
#let mist = rgb("#D9DEE2")
#let sail = rgb("#F4F5F6")
#let pcss-gold = rgb("#F4C91D")

#set page(
  paper: "us-letter",
  flipped: true,
  margin: (top: 0.28in, bottom: 0.48in, x: 0.42in),
  footer: context [
    #set text(
      font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
      size: 6.5pt,
      fill: slate,
      hyphenate: false,
    )
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 12pt,
      [#link("https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/")[#text(fill: navy)[CC BY 4.0]] - share and adapt with attribution to Andrew Andrade: #link("https://github.com/mrandrewandrade")[#text(fill: navy)[https://github.com/mrandrewandrade]]],
      [Page #counter(page).display("1 of 1", both: true)]
    )
  ]
)

#set text(font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"), size: 8.3pt, fill: charcoal, hyphenate: false)
#set par(leading: 0.46em, justify: false)

#let blank-field(label) = [
  #text(weight: "bold")[#label:]
  #h(5pt)
  #line(length: 1.8in, stroke: 0.55pt + slate)
]

#let page-header(side) = [
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    align: horizon,
    [
      #text(size: 20pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[The Way We Meet - Listening Notes]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 8.6pt, fill: slate)[Attention, connection, and making space for one another - #side]
    ],
    [#text(size: 7.6pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Technology Commons · Port Credit Secondary School]]
  )
  #v(3pt)
  #line(length: 0.58in, stroke: 3pt + pcss-gold)
  #v(2pt)
  #line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.2pt + navy)
  #v(4pt)
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr),
    column-gutter: 14pt,
    [#blank-field("Name")],
    [#blank-field("Class")],
    [#blank-field("Date")],
  )
  #v(4pt)
  #block(
    width: 100%,
    fill: sail,
    stroke: (left: 3pt + pcss-gold),
    inset: (left: 8pt, right: 8pt, top: 4pt, bottom: 4pt),
  )[
    #text(size: 7.7pt)[Make space for each speaker: phones away unless directed otherwise, face the speaker, avoid side conversations, and write one brief note for every presenter. Circle #text(weight: "bold")[A] = Attentive, #text(weight: "bold")[S] = Some lapses, or #text(weight: "bold")[N] = Not attentive. Be honest: an honest S or N is better than a false A. On the back, score your listening and explain the evidence for your choices.]
  ]
  #v(5pt)
]

#let notes-table(start, end, pad) = table(
  columns: (0.36in, 1.42in, 6.52in, 1.42in),
  inset: (x: 4pt, y: pad),
  stroke: 0.55pt + mist,
  align: left + top,
  table.header(
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[No.]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Presenter]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Listening note / connection / question / comment]],
    [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[My attention]] #linebreak() #align(center)[#text(size: 7pt, fill: slate)[A / S / N]]],
  ),
  ..range(start, end + 1).map(n => (
    [#n], [], [], [#align(center)[A / S / N]],
  )).flatten()
)

#page-header([Side 1 - Presenters 1-17])
#notes-table(1, 17, 6.0pt)

#pagebreak()
#page-header([Side 2 - Presenters 18-34])
#notes-table(18, 34, 3.0pt)

#v(4pt)
#block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: sail,
  stroke: (left: 3pt + pcss-gold),
  inset: (left: 8pt, right: 8pt, top: 4pt, bottom: 4pt),
)[
  #grid(
    columns: (1.08fr, 0.92fr),
    column-gutter: 14pt,
    [
      #text(size: 8.3pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Listening self-evaluation - use evidence]
      #v(2pt)
      #text(size: 6.7pt, fill: slate)[Score each area, then write a few words showing what you did or what you need to improve.]
      #v(2pt)
      #table(
        columns: (1.58in, 0.42in, 1fr),
        inset: (x: 3pt, y: 1.7pt),
        stroke: 0.45pt + mist,
        [#text(size: 6.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Area]], [#text(size: 6.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[/2]], [#text(size: 6.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[My evidence / next step]],
        [#text(size: 6.3pt, weight: "bold")[Attention & Presence] #linebreak() #text(size: 6.0pt, fill: slate)[phone away, face speaker, avoid side talk]], [___], [],
        [#text(size: 6.3pt, weight: "bold")[Audience Notes] #linebreak() #text(size: 6.0pt, fill: slate)[specific note for each presenter]], [___], [],
        [#text(size: 6.3pt, weight: "bold")[Discussion & Connections] #linebreak() #text(size: 6.0pt, fill: slate)[questions, comments, or connections]], [___], [],
        [#text(size: 6.3pt, weight: "bold")[Completion & Consistency] #linebreak() #text(size: 6.0pt, fill: slate)[kept up across both days; few/no gaps]], [___], [],
        [#text(size: 6.3pt, weight: "bold")[Integrity & Reflection] #linebreak() #text(size: 6.0pt, fill: slate)[honest A/S/N ratings; noticed and corrected lapses]], [___], [],
      )
      #v(2pt)
      #text(size: 7pt, weight: "bold")[My listening total: ____ /10]
    ],
    [
      #text(size: 8.3pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Learning Skills self-check]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 6.5pt, fill: slate)[Circle C = Consistently, S = Sometimes, or N = Not yet.]
      #v(2pt)
      #table(
        columns: (1.03in, 0.52in, 1fr),
        inset: (x: 2.5pt, y: 1.5pt),
        stroke: 0.45pt + mist,
        [#text(size: 6.3pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Skill]], [#text(size: 6.3pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[C / S / N]], [#text(size: 6.3pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[What it looked like]],
        [#text(size: 6.1pt, weight: "bold")[Responsibility]], [C / S / N], [#text(size: 5.9pt)[prepared, phone away, completed/submitted]],
        [#text(size: 6.1pt, weight: "bold")[Organization]], [C / S / N], [#text(size: 5.9pt)[notes complete, readable, and in order]],
        [#text(size: 6.1pt, weight: "bold")[Independent Work]], [C / S / N], [#text(size: 5.9pt)[worked without repeated reminders]],
        [#text(size: 6.1pt, weight: "bold")[Collaboration]], [C / S / N], [#text(size: 5.9pt)[respectful audience; supported speakers]],
        [#text(size: 6.1pt, weight: "bold")[Initiative]], [C / S / N], [#text(size: 5.9pt)[offered a question, comment, or connection]],
        [#text(size: 6.1pt, weight: "bold")[Self-Regulation]], [C / S / N], [#text(size: 5.9pt)[managed distractions and refocused after lapses]],
      )
      #v(2pt)
      #text(size: 6.5pt, weight: "bold")[Evidence from one skill I showed:] #line(length: 1.42in, stroke: 0.45pt + slate)
      #v(2pt)
      #text(size: 6.5pt, weight: "bold")[One skill to improve and what I will do next:] #line(length: 0.78in, stroke: 0.45pt + slate)
    ],
  )
  #v(3pt)
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, 1fr),
    column-gutter: 14pt,
    [
      #text(size: 7.4pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Activity feedback]
      #linebreak()
      #text(size: 6.5pt)[What helped you listen, connect, or learn from others?]
      #v(1pt)
      #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.45pt + slate)
    ],
    [
      #text(size: 7.4pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Improve it next time]
      #linebreak()
      #text(size: 6.5pt)[What should change to make this activity better?]
      #v(1pt)
      #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.45pt + slate)
    ],
  )
  #v(2pt)
  #text(size: 6.6pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Submit:] #text(size: 6.6pt)[Take clear photos of #text(weight: "bold")[both sides] and submit both images to Google Classroom after the final presentation day. Make sure your notes and self-evaluation are readable.]
]
```
